facts.text: I had a call with our client Hopper.
Hopper has an issue creating ads on a global level.
In the meeting, there are three user acquisition managers.
One user acquisition manager independently manages APAC.
One user acquisition manager independently manages LatAM and Canada.
One user acquisition manager independently manages Europe.
I talk with the user acquisition managers to go through their content needs.
The challenges include casting creators on a global level.
The challenges include creating the operational process around casting creators.
I am meeting with my ops team tomorrow to discuss how we can structure this project.
The goal of the call is to identify a process to create high quality content for all regions.
Jes is the Head of ops.
Jes owns the process and the ClickUp instance.
Jes ensures things are delivered on time with the right quality standard.
Etienne is a creative strategist.
Etienne researches and scopes different ad concepts.
Etienne creates briefs.
Etienne defines discovery criteria.
Ali is the Paid Media Director.
Ali is responsible for account growth.
I want to add Daniel as a stakeholder.
Daniel is a content production manager.
Daniel will chip in on voiceover and content ops.
I want to add Kat as a stakeholder as the top creator community manager.
I want to add Kat and Flor as SPMs on the project.
Flor will manage LatAm and Canada.
Kat will manage Europe.

events.text: Call with client Hopper to address global ad creation issue
Meeting with ops team tomorrow to structure the project
Add Daniel, Kat, and Flor as stakeholders for the project
Clarify regional ownership: Flor manages LatAm and Canada; Kat manages Europe
Clarify call goal: identify a process to create high quality content for all regions
